fields.title: AuraSage - Daily Affirmations
fields.short: Seven thoughtful affirmations a day, with reminders, voice and calm practice.
fields.full:
Build a more believable inner voice with daily affirmations designed for real life - not an endless feed of borrowed positivity.

AuraSage gives you seven thoughtful affirmations each day. Choose what lands, keep one close, and return when it is useful. There is no streak to protect and no pressure to perform wellness.

A SMALL DAILY PRACTICE

• Read a limited daily deck instead of scrolling forever
• Tell AuraSage what feels believable so future words fit better
• Carry one affirmation into your day
• Save favorites and write your own affirmations
• Use a 90-second Quick Reset when you need a calmer moment

PRACTICE YOUR WAY

Repeat daily affirmations silently, with narration, or in your own recorded voice. Choose rain, ocean, night, brown noise, or silence for free. Premium adds richer ambient scenes such as fireplace, forest, morning birds, a gentle stream, soft piano, and wind chimes.

REMINDERS WITHOUT THE GUILT

Set gentle affirmation reminders around your real day. Missing a day does not erase your progress. AuraSage notices that you returned; it does not turn your wellbeing into a scoreboard.

WORDS THAT FIT YOU

Choose focus areas, tone, and topics you would rather avoid. Save self-love affirmations, confidence affirmations, calming words, and personal reminders that feel useful to you. Hide anything that does not fit. Your feedback helps shape a more relevant daily practice.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your affirmation text, reflections, preferences, and voice recordings stay on your device. The core affirmation app works offline, and reminders are scheduled locally. AuraSage does not need your name, email, contacts, location, or health records for the core practice.

FREE ESSENTIALS, OPTIONAL DEPTH

The daily deck, favorites, custom affirmations, basic practice, reminders, Quick Reset, and core ambient sounds are genuinely useful for free. AuraSage Premium unlocks more collections, deeper personalization, your recorded voice in sessions, additional materials, and extra ambient scenes. Available plans and trial eligibility are shown clearly in the app before purchase.

Start with seven believable words for today. Keep the one you can actually mean.

AuraSage offers general wellness content, not medical or psychological treatment, diagnosis, or crisis support.
